q2_unresolved_numbers_root_cause.primary: LLM invents or rewrites numeric tokens not present in INPUT numbers_preserved / ALLOWED evidence surface
q2_unresolved_numbers_root_cause.example: 0.5016 as『52周区间中部』ratio — not in canonical numbers_preserved; pack=None cannot soft-ground via EvidencePack blobs
q2_unresolved_numbers_root_cause.secondary: LLM truncates/rounds INPUT numbers (e.g. 1341.99→1347.13 lookalikes) so token_map miss
q2_unresolved_numbers_root_cause.repair_behavior: Level1–2 attach evidence_ids when unique token match exists; no match → REGENERATE → client raises → grounded fallback
q2_unresolved_numbers_root_cause.not_validator_false_kill: Invented decimals genuinely unsupported under FACT freedom=0

q3_schema_failure_root_cause.observed: Existing _sanitize_llm_json already handles null-string, direction aliases, nested tension defaults
q3_schema_failure_root_cause.remaining: Occasional ValidationError on missing required nested fields / wrong list vs object after partial truncation

q4_citation_failure_mode.detail: Often numbers present in text WITHOUT evidence_ids; repair can fill when token∈INPUT. Failures are when number not in INPUT at all (invented), not merely missing citation format.

q5_repair_strictness.verdict: Repair is correctly strict for invented numbers; under-invested in regenerate-with-feedback and ALLOWED_NUMBERS prompting
q5_repair_strictness.not: Not over-rejecting unique INPUT-groundable numbers in the dominant failure sample (0.5016)

failure_before_repair_vs_after.before_repair: LLM JSON often passes schema but contains uncited/invented numbers
failure_before_repair_vs_after.after_repair_attempt: Unique INPUT matches get evidence_ids (REPAIR); invented tokens remain → REGENERATE raise → fallback
failure_before_repair_vs_after.gap: No single regenerate-with-unresolved_numbers feedback loop; no ALLOWED_NUMBERS hard list in prompt; no pin of Debate resolution before calibrate
